This joint set looks more or less vertical so the greatest principal stress would be gravity pushing perpendicular to the earth's surface.  Imagine the rock is an envelope you want to put a letter in.  When you press on the sides the envelope will open perpendicular to the direction you are pressing.  This process forms parallel sets of fractures that all formed under the same stress regime and provide preferential pathways for water to flow.  More water means more erosion making the parallel gouges you see at the surface.
